event.title: Spain Claims Second FIFA World Cup Title with Victory Over Argentina
event.canonical_title: Spain Claims Second FIFA World Cup Title with Victory Over Argentina
event.summary: Spain won its second men's World Cup by defeating Argentina 1-0 in the final, with Ferran Torres scoring the decisive goal in the 106th minute of extra time. This victory denied Lionel Messi a second consecutive title in what he indicated might be his final World Cup appearance. Fans celebrated the win across Spain, while Argentine supporters acknowledged their team's effort despite the loss.

timeline.title: Spain Claims Second FIFA World Cup Title with Victory Over Argentina
timeline.summary: Spain has won its second FIFA World Cup title, defeating Argentina 1-0 in the final match. Ferran Torres scored the decisive goal in extra time, securing the victory after a 16-year wait for the championship. Fans celebrated the win across Spain and in various locations worldwide, including Times Square in New York.
key_facts: Spain won the FIFA World Cup by defeating Argentina 1-0.
Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in extra time.
This victory marks Spain's second World Cup title, the first being in 2010.
